name: Should the tile backsplash be installed before or after the countertops?

mainEntity.name: Should the tile backsplash be installed before or after the countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: In full kitchen remodels, countertops must always be installed before the backsplash. Setting the countertops first establishes a permanent, level horizontal reference line along the wall. The bottom row of wall tile or marble can then be set directly above the slab, leaving a small expansion gap that is sealed with color-matched silicone caulking. Installing tile first creates uneven gaps, complicates stone templating, and risks breaking expensive tile work when heavy slabs are moved into position.
acceptedAnswer.description: Countertops should always be installed before the tile backsplash. This creates a level base for laying wall tile and protects your new tilework from damage during heavy stone placement.
